content: Label Sequence Optimization Layer: The Label Sequence Optimization Layer computes the probability of a labeling sequence and finds the sequence with the highest probability. In order to condition the label for each word on the labels of its neighbors, we employ a linear chain conditional random field (CRF) to define a global score, INLINEFORM0 , for a sequence of words and their associated scores INLINEFORM1 and labels, INLINEFORM2 : DISPLAYFORM0
